role: development-only; curated cases are functional demonstrations, not independent empirical projects

cases.originalOracle: chunks.flat() deep-equals array; every non-last chunk has length size; every chunk has length >0 and <=size
cases.adaptation: Two finite input bounds; Vitest assertions translated to the same three boolean checks; generic implementation specialized to number[]. Estimated manual edit: 19 lines of oracle glue, 0 changed assertions.
cases.expectedCapability: Concrete native fast-check; direct symbolic array projection and exact branch mapping require separate #395/#382 admission. Do not count unsupported mode as pass.

cases.expectedCapability: Concrete native fast-check; useful feedback depends on observed seed pattern and #397/#398, not guaranteed by this fixture.

cases.expectedCapability: Concrete native fast-check; retain even if feedback costs time without gain.

excludedInventory.reason: (x/3)*3 === x is false under JavaScript floating-point semantics (e.g. 1.8 gives 1.7999999999999998); a counterexample is a false specification, not an implementation defect. Keep as semantic diagnostic, not a fault count.
The source suite's unbiased distribution assertion is a probabilistic test of generator bias, not the deduplication oracle; distribution controls belong in generator experiments, not this core case.
